PC:
Initial Management:
Perform the initial primary survey: Airway, Breathing, and Circulation (ABCs)
Discuss the status epilepticus pathway maintained at our institution (lorazepam 0.1mg/kg followed by fosphenytoin 20 PE/kg)
Stabilize the patient by establishing access and assessing fluid status for fluid resuscitation, respiratory exam for impending respiratory failure, and neurologic exam

Advanced Management:
Discuss obtaining a CSF sample while considering a plan for the airway and sedation management
Intubation for respiratory failure secondary to status epilepticus
